law.construction: per group: dm_M = -0.1 m, v_M = K dm_M; q ~ N(0, I) float64 in exp_avg coordinates; q_perp = q - (<K q, v_M> / ||v_M||^2) dm_M; dm_R = (||v_M|| / ||K q_perp||) q_perp; exp_avg <- float32(float64(exp_avg) + dm_R); no division by K (AMENDMENT L76847)
law.targets: derived: dW_M(1) = W_M(1) - W_C(1) from the sha-pinned FMEL2 e1e-1 h = 1 snapshot and the fresh C (digest == locked FMEL2 C h = 1)
law.zero_norm: UNDEFINED = null + reason, never NaN; G needs the h = 1 norm, A needs G_r and G_M; an UNDEFINED A_r(H) -> REGIME-UNRESOLVED
